metaDesc: VNTV — a non-stop, trade-free science TV channel built from the VideoNeat.com collection.
dlConfirm: This link opens a video from {h}. Open it? Your IP address will be visible to that server.
searchPh: Search a topic to create a channel…
splashP: A non-stop broadcast of trailers from the VideoNeat collection: science documentaries, films and courses. Categories are channels, and every on-screen layer can be switched on or off.
offNote: You appear to be offline. VNTV streams from VideoNeat and needs an internet connection: reconnect, then press “Start broadcast”.
mobile: On a phone: swipe ↔ for clips, ↕ for channels, tap the screen for controls.

lower: Title, year, length and source when a clip starts
idents: Animated VNTV logo at every change
ambient: The clip's colors spill around the picture
vignette: Darkened edges, like in a theater
fill: Crops the picture to cover the whole screen
subs: From PeerTube, translated when your language isn't available

errList: Can't load the list from videoneat.com ({e}). VNTV has no offline content: it needs an internet connection to load the catalog and videos.
noTr: This channel has no trailers available.
slow: Clip is loading slowly — skipping ahead
unavail: Clip unavailable — moving on to the next one
noFavs: No favorites yet — press ★ while a clip is playing.
shufOn: Shuffle on — applies from the next channel change
shufOff: Chronological order — applies from the next channel change
cleanOn: Clean screen — press H to go back
note: VNTV plays the trailers. The full film is on the VideoNeat page or at the official source.
trOn: Automatic translation of the VideoNeat content
trNone: No translation engine available — originals are shown
trQuota: MyMemory's daily limit was reached — originals are shown
trHint: On-device translation is private and works in Chrome and Edge on computers. LibreTranslate is free software you can host yourself, e.g. on YunoHost. MyMemory is a commercial online service and is used only if you pick it.
a2hs: For true full screen: Share → Add to Home Screen
rotate: Turn your phone sideways for the full picture
noCast: Nothing to cast to was found
liveTip: Synchronized broadcast: everyone watching this channel sees the same clip right now
nonstopTip: Your own playlist — not synchronized with other viewers
mmWarn: MyMemory is a commercial online service: the titles and descriptions you view are sent to it. Choose it only if you accept that.
syncT: Everyone on the same channel sees the same clip at the same time, like real TV
syncNeedsIndex: The synchronized broadcast needs the official VideoNeat catalog (JSON). Until it is published, VNTV plays your own non-stop playlist.
netHint: P2P shares the load between viewers and lowers TROM's server costs, but makes your IP address visible to other viewers. Direct playback allows picture-in-picture, AirPlay and Chromecast.
ecoHint: Turns off blur and animated effects to save battery and run smoothly on modest devices.
catIndex: Catalog: official VideoNeat list ({n} titles with trailers).
catWP: Catalog: read from the VideoNeat website (slower; the synchronized broadcast is unavailable).
srcHint: Add PeerTube channels with openly licensed science videos — they become new channels with full-length videos. Example: https://instance/c/channel
kioskHint: Public screens: add ?kiosk=1 to the address (optionally &ch=3&lang=en&preset=cinema&muted=0). Press K three times to exit.
srcBad: That doesn't look like a PeerTube channel address (https://…/c/name or /a/name).
p2pFallback: The PeerTube player isn't responding — switched to direct playback.
p2pNote: P2P mode shares the video with other viewers to reduce TROM's server costs. Like any P2P, it makes your IP address visible to the viewers you exchange data with.
scrCastD: Send this video to a Chromecast, smart TV or AirPlay device on your network.
scrCastNo: Direct casting isn't available here (browser, device or current playback mode). Use the link or QR below on the TV, or cast the tab from your browser menu.
scrPipD: Keep the video floating above other windows.
scrWinD: Open the channel in its own window — drag it to a second monitor or projector.
scrWinBlocked: The browser blocked the pop-up — allow pop-ups for this page.
scrLinkD: Open this link in the browser of the other screen: it plays the same channel, full screen, with no controls, in sync with the schedule.
scrQr: QR code of the link for the other screen
scrHost: This copy runs from a file, so the link would not open on another device. Host the app (HTTPS) or use the options above.
splashTv: On a TV or another screen: after Start, open the Screen panel (monitor icon) for a link and QR code.
errSrc: Source unavailable or format not supported
errOffline: You're offline — playback resumes when the connection returns.
errChain: Several clips in a row failed to play. Pick an action:
logHint: Stays on this device only (last 60 events, no personal data); nothing is sent anywhere.
